reason: Most of my guests are tourists who come once. A loyalty reward and offers to regulars won't do much for them, and the reviews I live on are on Google and Tripadvisor, not some new app. I'll take the free staff board since I'm short two waiters, but I won't pay 59 a month on top of card fees.
objection: Dish ratings inside HoReCa Hub don't move my Tripadvisor score, and I already pay my terminal fees. This is one more fee and one more system for staff I don't have time to train.
would_change_my_mind: If a guest who pays by QR got pushed straight to leave a Google or Tripadvisor review, and pay-at-table really let me run the floor with one less waiter.
